issues.description: The problem statement and the example usage expect Farm to have a no-argument constructor that initializes the internal ArrayList, but the solution implements only a Farm(int initialCapacity) constructor. The template/Main also constructs Farm with new Farm(). This mismatch can confuse students and cause compilation/runtime issues when they follow the specification or the example code.
issues.suggestedFix: Provide a public no-argument constructor in Farm that initializes animals = new ArrayList<>(); (and optionally keep the existing Farm(int) overload). Alternatively, update the problem statement and example usages to require Farm(int initialCapacity) and adjust all examples accordingly. The preferred fix is to add a no-arg constructor to the solution's Farm to match the specification and template usage.
